title: RedMall: Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale E-commerce
abstract: arXiv:2611.08519v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation has shown considerable potential in industrial recommendation systems. However, the performance of existing generative methods is limited by several challenges. 1) Semantic IDs (SIDs) are treated as one-dimensional sequences, overlooking the hierarchical dependencies among different layers. 2) Next-token prediction used is unable to explicitly optimize session-wise recommendation. 3) Although reinforcement learning has been applied to align generated recommendations with user preferences, few existing methods explicitly optimize the ranking of positive items in session-wise recommendation. To address the above issues, we propose RedMall, a generative recommender designed for large-scale e-commerce. Firstly, RedMall constructs hierarchical SIDs through residual quantization over multimodal representations. Secondly, RedMall introduces a lightweight SID encoder to explicitly model layer-wise dependencies in SIDs.

translated_title: RedMall：面向大规模电商的生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐在工业推荐系统中已展现出可观的潜力。然而，现有生成式方法的性能受到以下几项挑战的制约：1) 语义ID（SID）被视为一维序列，忽略了不同层级之间的层次化依赖关系；2) 所使用的下一词元预测方法无法显式地优化会话级推荐；3) 尽管强化学习已被应用于将生成的推荐与用户偏好对齐，但现有方法中鲜有显式优化会话级推荐中正样本物品排序的。为解决上述问题，我们提出了RedMall，一个面向大规模电商的生成式推荐器。首先，RedMall通过对多模态表示进行残差量化来构建层次化语义ID（SID）。其次，RedMall引入了一个轻量级的SID编码器，以显式建模SID中的逐层依赖关系。
tldr: RedMall通过对多模态表示进行残差量化构建层次化语义ID，并引入轻量级SID编码器显式建模逐层依赖关系，解决了大规模电商场景下生成式推荐中语义ID层次依赖被忽略及会话级推荐优化不足的问题。
en_tdlr: RedMall addresses key limitations of generative recommendation in large-scale e-commerce by constructing hierarchical Semantic IDs through residual quantization over multimodal representations and introducing a lightweight SID encoder to explicitly model layer-wise dependencies.
